# alta_switch_port (Resource)

The VLAN membership of one physical switch port, written through the Alta cloud so the portal shows it.

Only the attributes below are managed. Other ports are left alone, and so are the port settings this resource does not model — speed, EEE, PoE, name and WAN role all survive a change here. The change is applied as one gated, commit-confirmed transaction — a single push to the router, rolled back automatically unless the health probes pass.

Destroying this resource removes it from Terraform state only. A port is physical: it cannot be deleted, and clearing its VLANs would cut off whatever is plugged into it, so the port keeps the configuration it was last given.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The uplink to a second switch: untagged on the LAN, with the isolated network tagged so
# it reaches the far side of the link.
#
# A port is physical, so this resource belongs to a device. It takes the provider's
# device_id; set device_id here only for a second router in the same site.
#
# Only the VLANs are managed. Speed, EEE and PoE stay whatever the portal has them set to,
# and destroying this resource leaves the port exactly as it is — a port is physical, so
# there is nothing to remove.
resource "alta_switch_port" "uplink" {
  port = 3

  native_vlan  = 2
  tagged_vlans = [20]
}

# Adopt a port the router already has by its number:
#
#   terraform import alta_switch_port.uplink 3
#
# Name a device or a site other than the provider's by putting them in the import id:
#
#   terraform import alta_switch_port.uplink "$DEVICE_ID/3"
#   terraform import alta_switch_port.uplink "$SITE_ID/$DEVICE_ID/3"
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `port` (Number) Physical port, numbered as the portal numbers it.

### Optional

- `all_vlans` (Boolean) Tag every VLAN on this port.
- `device_id` (String) Router this belongs to — its MAC address, lowercase without separators. Defaults to the provider's `device_id`.
- `native_vlan` (Number) Untagged VLAN; the default VLAN when omitted.
- `site_id` (String) Alta site. Defaults to the provider's `site_id`.
- `tagged_vlans` (Set of Number) VLANs tagged on this port, when `all_vlans` is false.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<site_id>/<device_id>/<port>`.
